units.translation: to keep the cities in concord
⟦1⟧ (g; conjectured by Bothe) is better than the weak ⟦2⟧ (Paley).

Still dactyls and trochees; the trochees of the simplest structure, namely three times two connected catalectic dimeters (binding by word-community twice in the antistrophe). The dactylic verse is usually restored as a logaoedic one, against the usage of this kind of strophe; but one can just as well scan ⟦1⟧ in the antistrophe and write ⟦2⟧⟨⟦3⟧⟩ in the strophe. The chorus prepares to depart to the dwelling-places to be assigned to it; thus the exodos is already prepared from here on.

⟦1⟧ occurs only in this passage; ⟦2⟧ (for one can also join into one word) Hesychius has with the explanation ⟦3⟧; as adjectives ⟦4⟧ like ⟦5⟧ are found in Homer. The sense must be: 'in the (or at the, ⟦6⟧ ⟦7⟧) wealth granted by fate'.

⟦1⟧ = ⟦2⟧ ⟦3⟧ (Frg. 58), proverb in Plat. ⟦4⟧ 575 C ⟦5⟧. But one must not mix in the ⟦6⟧ and ⟦7⟧ and the like, since it is not at all about descent, but only about the mighty protection of Pallas; so this is the pious belief of the Athenian, which Solon already expresses (4, 1 ff. Bgk): ⟦8⟧· ⟦9⟧ (see also ⟦10⟧, above 918 f.). The here meaningless ⟦11⟧ (in time, with time, 498 etc.) has been excellently emended by Weil into ⟦12⟧: ⟦13⟧ like ⟦14⟧.
Priam, who was born near the gods
But our city will never perish by the decree of Zeus and the mind of the blessed immortal gods
For such a great-hearted guardian, Pallas Athena, daughter of a mighty father, holds her hands over it
⟦1⟧ neither the verse nor the sense suffered. '⟦2⟧ metaphorically under the protection', taken from birds; so (Blaydes) ⟦3⟧; clearly Andr. 441 ⟦4⟧', ⟦5⟧, and Tro. 751.
